name: Piton
description: Piton was a terrestrial planet located in the Piton system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the sentient Piton species, which lived underground. Miro Daroon, who had become a member of the off-world Jedi Order at some point by approximately 53 BBY, was a Piton from the planet Piton.
lead_paragraphs: Piton was a terrestrial planet located in the Piton system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the sentient Piton species, which lived underground.
